title: Bear Tug
hook: Two teams, one rope, one very confused bear in the middle.

theme.keyArtPrompt: Two teams of cartoon kids pulling a giant rope while a puzzled bear sits on the middle of it, silly and dramatic, no text

sprites.player: cartoon kid pulling hard, side view
sprites.rope: giant striped rope with a bear sitting on it, side view

timeline.hostLine: The rope got slippery! Grip it tight!
Sudden death! Every tap counts double!

host.intro: Two teams. One rope. No mercy.
host.finale: The rope has chosen its champions. Well pulled, everyone.
host.tutorial: Mash PULL as fast as you can. Your team pulls together.
